entries.text: listed: the record names these components, and every row below is one the record carries
filtered: the typed text kept the rows below, and the count states how many rows matched
empty: the record states the page rendered no components, so this is an empty list and not a source that could not be read
cannot-tell: the source could not be read, so no list is rendered and the reason below states why
no-search-answer: no component-search answer was handed over, so no state, no row and no reason are reported
no-name: a row arrived with no name the record states, so no component name is rendered for it
no-instance-count: the record states no instance count for this component, so no count is rendered
no-rows: the answer carried no row list, so no row is rendered and no count is stated
no-reason: the answer reported cannot-tell without a reason, so no reason is stated
joined: the capture held at least one diagnostic, and every finding below is one diagnostic in the capture's own order
captured-nothing: a capture was read and carried no diagnostic, and a capture whose own attempt failed also emits nothing, so this states what was read and never that the page was silent
no-diagnostics: no capture was handed to the join at all, so no capture was read
no-console-answer: no console join answer was handed over, so no state and no finding are reported
no-finding: the answer reported joined and carried no finding, so no finding is rendered
no-code: the captured message carried no code, so this finding carries no code and no title
no-title: the digest carries the code this message carried and states no title for it, so no title is rendered
unreadable-finding: the answer carried a list entry that is not a finding, so it is named here and nothing is filled in for it
no-digest-entry: the digest carries no entry for {code}, so this finding is named by the code it carried and no title is rendered
case-difference: the message carried {carriedCode} and the digest carries {digestCode}, so this finding carries the digest's own spelling and title
case-difference-no-title: the message carried {carriedCode} and the digest carries {digestCode}, so this finding carries the digest's own spelling and no title is stated for it
handed-over: the text the pane drew is the text handed over, and the answer's control sentence names what will be sent before anything is sent
absence-carried: the absence this text names is carried in it as the pane stated it, and no part of it is filled in, inferred or repaired here
cannot-tell: the finding could not be expressed as a question, so nothing was handed over and no cause, element, remedy or rule identity is stated
no-hand-off-answer: no hand-off answer was handed over, so no state, no text and no reason are reported
no-control: the answer carried no control description, so what would be sent is not stated
no-body: the answer carried no body, so no text is handed over
no-reason: the answer reported cannot-tell without naming a reason, so no reason is stated
no-stability-observable: the page published no isStable stream this reader could reach, so no state and no reading are reported
no-cause-reported: isStable is a boolean stream and carries no reason, so no cause is reported
no-outstanding-inventory: the pending-task set holds bare task ids with no owner, no kind and no count, so no outstanding item is listed
no-settle-order: the pending-task set records no per-item order and no per-item settle time, so no first item to settle is reported
unstable: the page’s isStable emitted false
stable: the page’s isStable emitted true
cannot-tell: no isStable emission was reachable, so no state is claimed
idle: no isStable emission has been read yet, which is no verdict either way
no-settle-observed: the record carries no settle reading, so no time and no duration are reported
repeated work: the frame recorded no paired work
emission: isStable ${value} (the answer carries ${NO_EMISSION_TIME} for it)
emission: isStable ${value} at ${at} ms
settle: settled at ${at} ms (the answer carries no attach interval, so none is printed)
settle: settled at ${at} ms, ${since} ms after attach
${pair} ${subject}: ${count} ${word}
no-error-boundary-declared: the record names no error boundary on this page, so there is no declaring component and no caught-by mechanism to report
no-error-caught: the boundary hook is installed and caught nothing in this window, which is not the same as a page without a boundary
no-boundary-details: the arrival reached the error handler with no ErrorDetails, so it names no boundary and no caught-by mechanism
no-error-view-rendered: no rendered error view was found, so the content the boundary rendered instead was not recorded
no-replaced-subtree: the boundary removed the primary view and kept no record of it, so the pane cannot show what was replaced
no-global-error-listeners: the page declares no browser global error listeners, which is not evidence that no raw error happened
machinery-unconfirmed: the boundary machinery was not confirmed on this build, so the answer cannot be given
handler-unresolved: the error handler could not be resolved, so the boundary hook was never installed
hook-refused: the error handler refused the boundary hook, so no arrival could be recorded
no-core-version: the page reports no core version, so the pane can name only the version it works against
caught: a boundary caught an error
